mapper.select: SELECT id, definition_id, base_version_id, revision, content::text, published_version_id, published_definition_revision, updated_at FROM nw_skill_editing_drafts WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_skill_editing_drafts(id, definition_id, tenant_id, base_version_id, content) VALUES(#{id}, #{definitionId}, #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{baseVersionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{content}::jsonb)
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_skill_editing_drafts SET published_version_id=#{versionId}, published_definition_revision=#{definitionRevision}, updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND revision=#{revision} AND published_version_id IS NULL
